results.title: Top leader’s trip to US, Canada underscores Vietnam’s message in new era: FM
results.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs Le Hoai Trung has cast Party General Secretary and President To Lam's five-day trip through the US and Canada as a milestone that cemented the country's standing on the world stage.

results.title: US Iran war: Tehran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
results.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi emphasized that diplomatic solutions are essential for resolving tensions with the US and Israel. US President Donald Trump rejected Iran's proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, suggesting they are desperate for a deal. Despite this, Iranian officials remain hopeful that mediators will convey a definitive response from the US.
